identity: Tavi Rook. I fly the Sparrowhawk, pull salvage out of bad places, and fix whatever the ship breaks on the way home.
pressure: Cut the fuel feed, kill ignition, get everyone clear. Then we find out which hose decided it wanted a career change.
superstition: Don't whistle in my engine room. I know, I know—physics doesn't care. The engine does.
authority: No. I'm not signing a false manifest. Vey can clear us the slow way and enjoy the paperwork for both of us.
relationship: Sena comes if Sena wants the run—but with me, proper backup, and final call on navigation. Capable doesn't mean disposable.
boundary: Never been to Ash Crown. I don't know what's inside, and I'm not going to decorate the blank space with guesses.
